module: rs.core.manifest.psm1 — New-Manifest(-Receipt -Shards -Plan -Layout -RunContext -TreePath [-Family] [-InstructionSet]) → tree. Poor-man's template engine: templates/tree.template.md is the document pattern, templates/tree.notices.json is canned reader prose; the psm1 interpolates run facts. LANDED 2026-08-24 as a formatter; 2026-08-26 split template/notices from code, provenance as scalars, Chains from the colonel family (unused pass-through omitted). Packing settings are tree-global (SummaryLine); shards are header row + records only. tests/manifest.tests.ps1 (27).
$comment: Export phase 3 — the payload's declarations to the reader. Consumes the RECEIPT (measured offsets and byte lengths — only the writer knows), the PLAN (keys, groups, classes, oversized flags — reader hazards), and the LAYOUT (ColumnHeader from the resolved header row, not a hardcoded string). RunContext supplies provenance scalars (RunStamp, Root, GeneratorVersion, glob/mode/columns/config source). Family (colonel plan) is optional and becomes the Chains section. Notices/instructions are data, not hardcoded in the psm1. Writes exactly one file (the tree). Nothing flows back.

RunContext.note: provenance scalars — RunStamp, Root, GeneratorVersion, GlobSemantics, Patterns, Mode, Requested, Columns, ConfigSource — interpolated into the template; never dumped as nested JSON

Family.note: colonel plan (Variants, Routing/ExtensionMap, DefaultVariant) — formatted as ## Chains; unused pass-through omitted

Shards.note: the payload lines and every row's offsets

Path.note: leaf name in the Payload block

ByteLength.note: declared per shard so a reader knows the read size before reading

GroupKey.note: group name in payload lines / grouping summary

Class.note: Normal|Singleton|InBand|Oversized — Oversized → Hazards; classes summarized, not per-line noise

PlannedSizeBytes.note: cross-checked against ByteLength when both are in hand (belt and braces; serialize already asserted it)

ShardQuotaBytes.note: SummaryLine — the quota, named as a Size

ShardToleranceBytes.note: SummaryLine — quota + tolerance is the ceiling the reader may rely on, except for shards listed under Hazards

Format.note: 'psr' — format identity is declared here, not by the .txt extension

HeaderRowText.note: → ColumnHeader: the tree states the header row every shard carries, verbatim — one declaration, third sink

Model.note: what was rendered — kept in memory for tests / diagnostics; not a second artifact

Format.note: from templates/tree.notices.json — 'psr' plus the accommodation note (files are .txt so tools read them whole)

SummaryLine.note: Grouping | GroupSort | OrderStrict | ShardQuotaBytes | ShardToleranceBytes | Created | Shards — from plan + RunContext, never preformatted upstream

PayloadLines.note: tree file first, then one line per shard: leaf name, files:N, bytes:N, group

ColumnHeader.note: tree row metadata legend AND the psr header row verbatim (layout.HeaderRowText)

Hazards.note: one per oversized shard; empty when none — the reader's 'every shard ≤ ceiling except these'

Provenance.note: RunContext object kept on the model; the tree renders flattened scalars, not a JSON dump

Chains.note: from Format-FamilyChains; empty when -Family is omitted

ByteLength.note: actual size — how far over the ceiling the reader must be prepared to read whole

Reason.note: 'single record exceeds quota + tolerance; kept whole (atomicity)'
